title: StrategyRetired.v1
description: A strategy version left ACTIVE and no longer decides (A§60, plan §6.5 catalogue extension). Emitted by strategy-service on `collections.strategy` keyed by `strategyId`. The usual cause is a newer version being activated in the same transaction (`SUPERSEDED`), which is why consumers must handle this event and `StrategyActivated` as one atomic pair rather than assuming a gap with no active version. Retirement is terminal: a retired version is never re-activated — a clone becomes a new version and walks the governance lifecycle again.

strategyId.description: Identifier of the strategy family, e.g. `EARLY_COLLECTION`. Also the partition key.

reason.description: OPTIONAL — why it was retired, as a stable code: `SUPERSEDED` (a newer version was activated in the same transaction), `EFFECTIVE_TO_REACHED` (the auto-retire tick passed its `effectiveTo`), `MANUAL` (an operator retired it with no replacement). Omitted, never null, when the producer has no better answer than "a retirement happened". A code and not free text: any commentary belongs on the append-only `strategy_transition` row, which is the audit record, while the event carries only vocabulary consumers can branch on.
